text: {"101":{"about":["rustc_middle","rustc_arena"],"refers":[],"why":"Compiler values are arena-allocated and subsequently represented by references, using the compiler arena implementation."},"102":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"The compiler's type interning machinery canonicalizes identical values so they are shared and cheaply pointer-compared."},"103":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle defines several core intermediate representations whose values are allocated and interned by compiler infrastructure."},"104":{"about":["rustc_query_impl","rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"The query system is implemented by rustc_query_impl, with its query definitions and modifiers specified in rustc_middle."},"105":{"about":["rustc_query_impl"],"refers":[],"why":"The query engine implements the demand-driven organization of compilation rather than a fixed sequential pass pipeline."}}
